entry.title: Long-Horizon Agent Planning with Memory
entry.summary: We study how language model agents plan over long horizons and show that a simple memory mechanism improves success rates on multi-step tasks while reducing cost. entry.title: Sparse Attention Kernels
entry.summary: A study of GPU kernels for sparse attention with measured speedups across sequence lengths and head counts, including detailed ablations on memory bandwidth and occupancy.
